method: Inspected source sheets, accepted proof-idle.png, and exported full-size PNGs.
Sampled actual playing browser canvas on light/dark backgrounds and boss 96px inset.
Sampled exported root idle GIF playing on simultaneous dark/light panels, including its small inset (approximately 52px character height).
Inspected manifests, alpha bounding boxes and opaque-pixel RGB means. Rechecked corrected exports after reload.

resolvedFindings.before: Healthy frame0 was approximately24px left of remaining poses, affecting both feet and crown.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Technical horizontal registration corrected; final bbox x values161,162,162,162. No whole-body hop observed on recheck.

resolvedFindings.before: Wounded idle was approximately60px left of healthy idle.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Corrected low-body registration brings wounded bbox x164–166 alongside healthy161–162; sideways transition hop removed.

resolvedFindings.before: Generic pingpong repeated right sway because four source poses already form a cycle.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Sequence changed to0,1,2,3 and verified in final manifest.

checks.grounding: pass: all idle alpha bounds end at y510; no vertical floating; residual local foot/stone contours differ slightly.
checks.lighting: pass: no broad flicker observed; mean opaque RGB variation <=0.6/channel boss and <=1.9 root.
checks.identity: pass: crown prong pattern, facial mask, heart, leaf mantle remain recognizable against proof; local drawing contours vary.
checks.loopSeams: pass_with_notes: healthy and wounded pingpong reverse adjacent frames; root uses direct cyclic order. Four-pose motion remains visibly stepped at full scale.
checks.articulation: pass: arm/crown breathing and root neck lean occur relative to planted lower body.
checks.smallScale: boss readable at96px character height; root silhouette readable at approximately52px GIF inset; exact96px root view not independently tested.
checks.transparency: pass: suspected red fringe in raw viewer absent on actual composited dark/light preview and GIF.

residualNotes.finding: Root stone/base and boss foot/foliage contours are not pixel-identical across authored frames.
residualNotes.impact: Minor contour shimmer possible at full resolution; no major sliding observed after registration.
residualNotes.recommendation: Optional future authoring pass if user demands pixel-stable idles; retain current requested artwork now.

residualNotes.finding: Wounded idle is subtly slumped with lower fists but visually close to healthy state.
residualNotes.impact: State difference may be weak at96px.
residualNotes.recommendation: Optional later stronger fatigue posture or heart dimming; not required to repair current loop.

limitations: This is sampled visual playback plus source/frame inspection, not a continuous video motion measurement.
Non-idle states, VFX, gameplay integration and gallery approval are outside this review.
Technical QA is not design approval and does not certify perfect animation.
